title: Fisher House
subtitle: The Fairway Villa on Caleta Yalku
description:
Perfectly positioned on the tranquil Caleta Yalku, this elegant single-story residence offers a rare blend of absolute privacy and effortless convenience. Situated just a two-minute stroll from the vibrant marina, fine dining, and local boutiques of Puerto Aventuras, the home provides a frontline view of the lush, manicured greens of the golf course, creating a lifestyle defined by serenity and exclusivity.

The architectural brilliance of this home lies in its single-level fluidity. A welcoming foyer opens into a vast, open-concept living and dining space that naturally draws the eye toward the outdoors. The fully equipped culinary kitchen integrates seamlessly with the social areas, while massive glass doors dissolve the boundary between the interior and the expansive covered terrace. This outdoor living room is perfectly designed for al fresco dining, leading directly to a private pool and verdant garden that blend harmoniously with the golf course horizon.

The private wing of the estate features three generously appointed bedrooms and three full bathrooms, alongside dedicated, discrete staff quarters. The sun-drenched primary suite is a true retreat, offering a private sitting area and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with dual vanities. The first guest suite introduces a touch of authentic Mexican heritage with a breathtaking traditional brick dome ceiling (Cúpula de Ladrillo), while the third bedroom ensures ultimate comfort for family or visiting guests.

Every technical detail has been considered to ensure a zero-friction lifestyle. The property is delivered with a comprehensive whole-house water softening system, a dedicated laundry facility, and a secure two-car garage. This is more than a residence; it is a turnkey invitation to experience the very best of the Mexican Caribbean in one of its most secure and distinguished gated communities.
highlights: Single-story home with golf course views
Open-concept living with fully equipped kitchen
Traditional brick dome ceiling in second bedroom
Two-car garage and dedicated laundry room
Located in prestigious Puerto Aventuras gated community
Two-minute walk to restaurants and shops
